## Product Intelligence - AI Extraction (v3: chunked)
Document is split into sections (separator lines, headings; delivery lists kept apart), each part is extracted separately, results are merged, then `apply_ai_extraction` validates and writes. Failed parts are recorded (run becomes `partial` and is retried up to 3 times). Requires SQL 003. Bump `prompt_version` in Config to re-extract all documents.
